item.examplemod.manual.tooltip: Everything the 3 buttons and the brush do
examplemod.manual.title: Animal Exploitation
examplemod.manual.author: The farm
examplemod.manual.p1:
ANIMAL EXPLOITATION MANUAL

Three buttons and a brush.

Each button spawns its animal (chicken, cow or sheep) with a burst of party effects.
examplemod.manual.p2:
CHICKEN BUTTON (red)

Spawns chickens of a random variant. They are indestructible: no fire, no sword.

Recipe: 2 redstone, 1 egg or feather, 2 iron, 1 TNT, 2 stone, 1 lightning rod.
examplemod.manual.p3:
COW BUTTON (black)

Same, but with cows of any variant.

Recipe: same as the chicken one, but the centre is 1 leather or beef and the corners are 2 black dye.
examplemod.manual.p4:
SHEEP BUTTON (white)

Same, but with sheep in one of the 16 random colors.

Recipe: same, but the centre is 1 white wool or mutton and the corners 2 white dye.
examplemod.manual.p5:
WHAT HAPPENS ON PRESS

80% the animal spawns.
15% explosion at the button: lots of noise and smoke, pushes and hurts, but never kills.
5% dragon + night lightning.
examplemod.manual.p6:
CELESTIAL RAY

1% of the time a celestial ray falls: a pillar of light that clears the terrain down to bedrock and kills every living thing... except the animal of that button.

Sneak while pressing: it always falls, for testing.
examplemod.manual.p7:
PAINTBRUSH

Right-click a chicken, cow or sheep: changes its color, cycling through the 16 Minecraft colors in order.

Sneak: back to the previous color.

Recipe: 3 wool (any color), 1 iron and 2 sticks.
examplemod.manual.p8:
NOTES

Sheep store their color like in vanilla.

The cow and chicken carry theirs in an invisible mark: everyone sees the same and it is saved to the world.

Mushroom cows cannot be painted.
